name: Thijs Reuten - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2025
part_text:
**What this report asks for**

This report is the European Parliament's yearly opinion on European security and defence. It does not change any law. It calls for much more joint spending on defence, faster weapons production, and a real single market for defence products. It wants Europe to stand more on its own, keep supporting Ukraine, and treat Russian hybrid attacks, such as airspace violations and sabotage, as a serious threat. It also asks for stronger European command structures and better protection of critical infrastructure.

**Key points**

- It asks for joint defence buying, a bigger European defence industry and more money, but changes no law itself.
- It affects EU governments, defence companies, and countries like Ukraine and Moldova that receive EU support.
- Next, Parliament votes on the text, then sends its requests to EU governments and the Commission.
